Dear [Mr Macmillan](../persons.html#942)
I hope to send all but the three or four concluding chapters of my story, [A Release or Caroline’s French Kindred](../books.html#239) tomorrow
I should very much like them to appear in [St Nicholas](../others.html#88), but the difficulty is that the really first part is in the Christmas Number of the [Monthly Packet](../others.html#52) for 1893, and if this story appeared separately, I must rewrite the mise en scene, as I suppose the republication of Caroline’s Defiance would be objected to. I cannot lay my hand on the Xmas number, perhaps you could procure it from [Mr Innes](../persons.html#744). I doubt however whether my story has enough of the child element in it for St Nicholas
Yours very truly

C M Yonge
